title: files/<manifest path>/_wad.yaml (census export, format 2)

fileId.description: the manifest's id for this version of the file; changes whenever its bytes do

tags.description: the tags the manifest gives the file (locales, platforms), sorted; empty for none

description: A WAD's own fields: its format version, and the manifest's file id and tags for it. Its entries are files beside it, in the bucket of their path hash's first byte: <xx>/<path hash>.yaml for every entry (schema entry), and for a bin <path hash>.bin/<yy>/<entry hash>.rito, each of its entries as ritobin text, in the bucket of the entry hash's first byte.
